description: Every contract item of the CRW-189 Wave 0 analysis (contracts.md K1-K14 and section 2, every tests.md class-A file, the inventory's environment and state tables) and how this corpus holds it. `crw-dev cxc record` keeps each recorded item's fixture list in sync with the fixtures' covers; `crw-dev cxc lint` checks the index. Path-length dependent fixtures (a byte count or a cut over an expanded case-root path) are listed in path_length_dependent: a replay compares them only with case roots and plugin root of the recording's lengths (/var/tmp/cxc-rec-<16 hex>, oracle at /var/tmp/cxc-v0.2.40-rec).

statuses.recorded: fixtures under contract/fixtures/cxc hold it; fixtures lists them
statuses.extracted: frozen as data, not as a scenario; evidence names the file
statuses.pending: not recorded yet; spec holds the exact scenarios to add to a spec file, or method says how to record or extract it
statuses.not-recordable: a recording cannot hold it as data; reason says why and where it belongs instead

items.contract: `ps -o lstart= -p <pid>` for background job identity (bg-wake/src/registry.ts:71).
`cxc bg cancel <id>` on a live job kills its process group and records status cancelled.
items.method: Needs a live process started by `bg run` (K6/bg/run); the finished-job half is recorded (cli__bg__cancel_does_not_overwrite_finished_job).

items.contract: `cxc bg run [--note] [--json] -- <cmd>` spawns a detached shell that writes <id>.out and <id>.exit, records the job (id bg + 6 hex, pid, startToken from `ps -o lstart=`), and a later Stop wakes on it.

spec.note: bg run spawns a detached sh that outlives the step; the recorder must wait for <id>.exit (the id is random, aliased <BG_1>) before the next step, and give `ps` a stub or the real program. Then bg list --json shows the reconciled failed record (exit 3) and the Stop wakes on it.

items.method: Needs a recorder step that waits for a file to appear (the detached child's <id>.exit) and a `ps` on PATH; the detached process must be reaped by session id at the end of the scenario.

items.contract: JSON Schemas for the state records (State/defaultState, Goalplan v1-v3, interview ledger rows, subagent evidence, receipts, session source, metrics, divergence, bg registry, dispatch records, subagents.json, recall index DDL), validated against every file the fixtures observe.
items.method: Run `npx tsc --declaration --emitDeclarationOnly` over components/*/src in a copy of the oracle, hand-convert the exported record types to JSON Schema under contract/schema/cxc/state/, and add a lint step that validates every observed tree entry of the matching path against its schema. The fixtures already freeze each file's concrete content (K8/* items); the schemas generalise them.
